description: Turn a recipe the cook pasted, typed or linked to into a Befana draft: ingredients matched to Befana's list, steps rewritten in plain words with amounts as tags, and servings, times, timers and tags filled in. Pass text (up to 20,000 characters) or url (a public recipe page; a Pinterest Pin or pin.it link works too: Befana follows the Pin to the recipe it saved), not both. Nothing is published. Show the cook the draft (title, servings, ingredients and steps), point out anything listed in guessed, and ask them to confirm or change it. Then publish with create_recipe({ draft_id }) plus only the fields they changed, or give them edit_url to review and publish on the website. For a photo of a recipe card, read it yourself and pass the text. Limited to 20 drafts a day per cook.

text.description: The recipe as the cook gave it, in any format

url.description: A public recipe page (http or https), or a Pinterest Pin link

name: draft_recipe
title: Draft a recipe from text or a link
